summary: MarketBeat's "The UNTHINKABLE Happened to These AI Stocks (Why They'll Win Again Soon)" (published 2026-09-29, ~22:58 BST) is an in-studio interview with guest Mark Chaikin of Chaikin Analytics — all stock calls in the video are his, not MarketBeat staff. The discussion frames the next phase of the AI bull market: Chaikin compares today's compute buildout to the 1990s fiber boom, arguing we're at a "midterm buying opportunity" with ~20% market upside into mid-2027, and that fears of hyperscaler debt and data-center pushback will fade after the midterms. His three picks are early AI adopters that corrected hard but re-established uptrends: Palantir (PLTR, BUY) — bottomed after a >50% pullback tied partly to controversy over its Iran-war involvement, now has a bullish Chaikin Power Gauge rating and he expects new highs given its high-beta leverage to a market rally; ServiceNow (NOW, BUY) — recovered from a downbeat-quarter selloff, moved back into the bullish camp as AI integration into its corporate workflow tools gains traction; Advanced Micro Devices (AMD, CONDITIONAL BUY) — up ~30% since his free recommendation six weeks earlier (trillion-dollar valuation reached), but he says to buy 5–8% pullbacks, not new highs. Other tickers discussed: NVDA (the single chip supplier AMD challenges), DELL, SanDisk, Adobe, Salesforce, GOOGL, AMZN, META, ORCL. No explicit prices stated. Note: the video carries sponsored Power Gauge marketing with a same-day "deadline" CTA, and Chaikin openly admits he's "not a tech person" on Palantir's moat specifics.
title: The UNTHINKABLE Happened to These AI Stocks (Why They'll Win Again Soon)
creator: MarketBeat

calls.thesis: Guest Mark Chaikin: Palantir bottomed out after a >50% pullback, power gauge bullish again, established uptrend; government + enterprise data processing moat, "leader in the next wave of the AI boom".
calls.base_case: Chaikin thinks PLTR makes a new high as market rises ~20% over next 9 months from midterm low.
